11072|e23ef030.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|e23ef030.text: What brings you to the Tower?

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

248415|72040e11.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|72040e11.text: I kinnae help ye with trainin'. Ye should look fer a $c trainer.

249713|0c768ee1.name: Odd Child
249713|0c768ee1.text: Shhh! You'll give away my hiding spot!

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

103-accept.name: Captain Grayson
103-accept.text:
The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible.  I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack.  But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline.  With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.

Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
103-accept.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-complete.name: Captain Grayson
103-complete.text:
Praise you, brave $C.  The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work.  Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.

I died needlessly on this very shore.  My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
103-complete.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-accept.name: Captain Grayson
104-accept.text:
When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me.  The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off.  They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again.  The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.

Slay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
104-accept.title: The Coastal Menace

104-complete.name: Captain Grayson
104-complete.text: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead.  Well done, $N.  By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved.  The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
104-complete.title: The Coastal Menace

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

152-accept.name: Captain Grayson
152-accept.text:
You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.

Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
152-accept.title: The Coast Isn't Clear

152-complete.name: Captain Grayson
152-complete.text: Well done, $N.  You have quite a knack for combat.  Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.
152-complete.title: The Coast Isn't Clear

155-accept.name: The Defias Traitor
155-accept.text:
So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. 

You know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.

Let me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
155-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

155-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
155-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
155-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

16-complete.name: Gerard Tiller
16-complete.text: Thanks, $N!  And come back if you want to trade again.
16-complete.title: Give Gerard a Drink

16-progress.name: Gerard Tiller
16-progress.text:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
16-progress.title: Give Gerard a Drink

166-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-accept.text: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
166-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

214-accept.name: Scout Riell
214-accept.text:
It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $N.
214-accept.title: Red Silk Bandanas

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

79092-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79092-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79092-progress.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?
91775-progress.title: Book Return

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books
